**Reviewer:** boundary-reviewer

```
BD-1 (blocker, BEH-39 / BEH-37 / BEH-32). The spec names resolveContained() from lib/path-safety.mjs as the containment primitive for spec_ref/planRef consumers and for the fixture recorder. That helper is lexical only: it reduces to abs.startsWith(absRoot + sep), never calls realpath, and has no ENOENT branch. spec_ref/planRef come from Project fields that project writers control, not repository committers, so a committed symlinked directory can pass the lexical check and resolve outside the root. assertContained in lib/extensions/exec-payload.mjs closes this gap (realpath'd base and candidate, refuse an unresolvable candidate, lexical pre-check). The sentinel's 'resolved path must lie inside the storage root' does not mention realpath and defers to charter rev 9. Recommendation: require realpath'd containment equivalent to assertContained (or lenientRealpath plus isContained) for every consumer that opens spec_ref/planRef, for the fixture recorder, and for the sentinel write and read. Refuse an unresolvable candidate, and refuse a symlinked sentinel with SENTINEL_PATH_UNSAFE. Do not cite resolveContained as sufficient.
```
